That's a really thoughtful approach to having these conversations. In terms of affordability, there are programs like period product banks or free menstrual product distribution programs that some schools have implemented. These can be really helpful for students who may not have access to these products otherwise.

As for products for trans students, that's a great point. Some companies are starting to develop products that are more inclusive, like period-proof underwear or products that cater to different body types and identities. It's a great example of how companies and organizations can adapt to better serve diverse needs.
